test_cases.query: 晶圆级封装的成本和优势
test_cases.reference_answer: WLP在晶圆级别同时处理芯片，设备利用率提升3-5倍，单颗封装成本降低30-40%。
FinFET是三维晶体管结构，鳍片三面被栅极包裹，3nm以下向GAA结构演进。

test_cases.query: 多重曝光技术 SADP SAQP
test_cases.reference_answer: 多重曝光技术突破光刻分辨率极限，SADP通过芯轴+侧墙实现图形倍增。

test_cases.query: LayoutParser document layout detection model zoo
test_cases.reference_answer: LayoutParser provides a unified toolkit for DL-based document image analysis with a model zoo of pre-trained layout detection models.
LayoutParser wraps OCR engines like Tesseract and Google Cloud Vision API for easy integration with layout detection.
